user.title: Set up Sternchenplan
user.description: Four short steps and you are ready to go.

members.title: Who is in the family?
members.description: Tick everyone who takes part. Phones for reminders are detected automatically.

data_description.extra_children: Optional, comma separated, e.g. Lucas, Osmo.

parents.title: Who are the parents?
parents.description: Parents can create and approve chores. Everyone else is a child.

chores.title: What do you want to start with?
chores.description: Suggestions that suit your children's ages. Shared chores rotate, children who are too young are skipped. Add your own chores afterwards in the sidebar under Sternchenplan → Chores.

ages.title: How old are the children?
ages.description: Age in years. Each child only gets chores that suit their age and automatically moves into new chores as they grow older. You can leave it empty.

rewards.title: Which rewards are there?
rewards.description: Children earn points with completed chores and redeem them here. You confirm every redemption. Add your own rewards and prices later under Sternchenplan → Rewards.

photos.title: Photos and privacy
photos.description: For chores with photo proof, children take a photo that only parents can see. Photos stay in your Home Assistant and never leave it. You decide per chore whether photo proof is needed; it is off by default.

tablet.title: Family tablet
tablet.description: Children without their own phone? Pick the HA account of the shared tablet (e.g. in the kitchen). Children tap their name there and tick off chores. Leave empty if you have no tablet. Parents can always tick off for a child too.

data.tablet_approval: Parents confirm what was ticked off on the tablet

error.no_members: Please select or enter at least one family member.

data_description.user: Links this member to a login, so permissions are checked when they use the app.

data_description.reminder_times: Comma separated, e.g. 15:00, 17:00, 18:30. Only sent if something is still open.

consequences.title: Internet lock
consequences.description: When a child still has overdue chores during the lock window, the internet of their chosen devices is switched off. It comes back as soon as everything is done, or at the end of the window. Do not add phones.

devices_select.title: Devices for {member}
devices_select.description: Choose the internet switches of leisure devices, e.g. from the FRITZ!Box integration (Internet access).

rules.title: Taking over & photos
rules.description: Siblings can take over open chores of others and get the points. Leave the time empty to turn it off.

data.photo_retention_days: Otherwise delete at the latest after (days)
data.photo_delete_after_review: Delete photos right after approving or rejecting

announcements.title: Speaker announcements
announcements.description: At these times Sternchenplan announces who still has open chores today. If everything is done, it stays quiet. Choose speakers plus a text-to-speech engine (e.g. Google Translate, Piper) or a service that speaks by itself (e.g. Alexa Media Player). Both work together.

data_description.announce_times: Comma separated, e.g. 17:00, 18:30. Leave empty to turn off.

ages.title: How old are the children?
ages.description: Age in years. Each child only gets chores that suit their age and automatically moves into new chores as they grow older. You can leave it empty.

tablet.title: Family tablet
tablet.description: Children without their own phone? Pick the HA account of the shared tablet (e.g. in the kitchen). Children tap their name there and tick off chores. Leave empty if you have no tablet. Parents can always tick off for a child too.

data.tablet_approval: Parents confirm what was ticked off on the tablet

error.invalid_member: Name missing or this user is already linked to a member.
error.tts_missing: Please also choose a text-to-speech engine for the speakers.

options.delete: Delete right after we approve or reject (recommended)
options.keep: Keep for 7 days, then delete automatically

set_absence.name: Set absence
set_absence.description: Parents only. Chores go to the next in rotation or the substitute.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.description: Who takes over chores that don't rotate.

set_devices.name: Set devices
set_devices.description: Parents only. Internet switches that are locked for overdue chores.

grant_pass.name: Grant free pass
grant_pass.description: Parents only. No lock until the given time.

until.name: Until
until.description: Default: end of tonight's lock window.

take_over_chore.name: Take over chore
take_over_chore.description: A sibling takes over someone else's open chore and gets the points.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: ID from the chore sensor's chore_id attribute.

member.name: Member
member.description: Who did it. Defaults to the caller.

announce.name: Make announcement
announce.description: Announces on the configured speakers what is still open today, or your own text.

message.name: Text
message.description: Leave empty to announce open chores.

set_age.name: Set age
set_age.description: A child's age in years. Chores with a minimum age only go to children who are old enough.

create_reward.name: Create reward
create_reward.description: New reward children can redeem with points.

members.name: For whom
members.description: Children (name or ID). Empty = all children.

update_reward.name: Update reward
update_reward.description: Change name, points or children of a reward.

delete_reward.name: Delete reward
delete_reward.description: Deletes a reward. Open redemptions stay.

redeem_reward.name: Redeem reward
redeem_reward.description: A child redeems a reward. Points are deducted, parents confirm.

approve_redemption.name: Confirm redemption
approve_redemption.description: Parents confirm the child gets the reward.

reject_redemption.name: Reject redemption
reject_redemption.description: Rejects and gives the points back.

set_goal.name: Set savings goal
set_goal.description: A child picks a reward to save up for. Without a reward the goal is removed.

reward_id.name: Reward ID
reward_id.description: ID of the reward. Empty removes the goal.

set_family_goal.name: Set family goal
set_family_goal.description: All children collect stars together for a shared goal, e.g. a trip. Nothing is deducted from the children.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the family is saving for.

target.name: Stars
target.description: How many stars all children need together.

set_money.name: Pocket money settings
set_money.description: Exchange rate for stars and the weekly payday.

rate.name: Stars per euro
rate.description: How many stars a child exchanges for 1 €. 0 turns exchanging off.

payday.name: Payday
payday.description: Weekday for the weekly allowance: 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday.

set_allowance.name: Set weekly allowance
set_allowance.description: Fixed amount a child gets every week on payday.

amount.name: Amount
amount.description: Euros per week. 0 turns it off.

exchange_stars.name: Exchange stars
exchange_stars.description: A child exchanges stars for pocket money at the family's rate.

payout.name: Pay out
payout.description: Parents hand over the money. The balance goes down.

adjust_money.name: Book money
adjust_money.description: Add or subtract an amount, e.g. a bonus.

check_step.name: Tick off routine step
check_step.description: Ticks off one step of a routine. When all steps are done, the chore counts as reported.

index.name: Step
index.description: Number of the step, starting at 0.

set_pause.name: Holiday pause
set_pause.description: Nothing is due and nothing is locked during this time. Afterwards due dates move forward and streaks continue.

set_picture_mode.name: Picture mode
set_picture_mode.description: Large pictures instead of text for a child who can't read yet.

enabled.name: On
enabled.description: Switch picture mode on or off.

set_weather.name: Weather
set_weather.description: Which weather entity decides about outdoor chores. Empty = off.

set_report.name: Weekly report
set_report.description: When parents get the weekly report.

send_report.name: Send weekly report now
send_report.description: Sends the report of the last 7 days to the parents.

give_stars.name: Bonus or deduction
give_stars.description: Give extra stars or take some away. A deduction never goes below zero and never lowers a level.

reason.name: Reason
reason.description: Shown to the child, e.g. “Helped with shopping”.

add_preset.name: Add quick button
add_preset.description: A ready-made bonus or deduction for the parent view.
